scope: Canonical display names for the matched PathoTME study. Stored condition IDs remain unchanged.

native.description: The matched underlying model without TME.

tme_only.description: L2 logistic regression using only the matched numeric TME panel.

late_fusion_fixed_half.description: An equal average of Native and PathoTME-LR class probabilities.

late_fusion_validation.description: Native and PathoTME-LR probability fusion with the TME weight selected on validation patients.

actual.description: A learned conditioner using the slide’s own TME measurements with a frozen native checkpoint.

zero.description: The adapter ablation with standardized numeric TME inputs set to zero.

shuffled.description: The adapter ablation with a different patient’s TME row from the same data split.

fusionval_selection: Validation patient AUROC, then NLL, then smaller alpha; endpoints remain eligible.
lr_scope: One fit per matching cohort, panel and fold; independent of visual architecture and encoder.
short_table_alias_requirement: The caption must explicitly identify these as adapter ablations.
algorithm_note: PathoTME is the study umbrella. LR and probability fusion are standard baseline algorithms.
